# [EPIC] Buildable project foundation: module layout, root Gradle build, CI templates, local infrastructure

## Epic
Deliver the foundation every later service is built on:

1. Directory structure for the 9 backend modules, the frontend,
   infrastructure and docs.
2. A root Gradle build that gives all 9 modules one Java toolchain, one
   Spring Boot and Spring Cloud version set, and one coverage setup.
3. GitHub issue and pull request templates, two CI workflows, and
   Dependabot across 4 ecosystems.
4. A Docker Compose stack for local development, with PostgreSQL, MongoDB
   and Redis behind healthchecks and named volumes.

## Business Value
Without this there is no agreed place for code to land and no build that
compiles it. Every later Story depends on it, so its cost is paid once and
recovered by every issue after it.

## Product Goal alignment
Indirect. This epic ships no platform feature. It is what makes the
self-hosted TMDB-shaped microservices platform in
`docs/process/PRODUCT_GOAL.md` buildable at all.
